english.title: Designated premises supervisor knowingly allow children in certain relevant premises - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the designated premises supervisor for **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), knowing they were relevant premises within section 145(4) of the Licensing Act 2003, allowed an unaccompanied child to be on those premises when they were open exclusively or primarily for the supply of alcohol for consumption there
english.legislation: Contrary to section 145(1)(a), (3)(b)(ii) and (9) of the Licensing Act 2003.

english.notes:
(i) See section 145(4) for the premises to which the offence relates
(ii) See section 145(2) for the meaning of the term "child".
(iii) See sections 145(5) and (6) for the defences.
(iv) See section 145(10) for the meaning of the term "supply of alcohol".
